column3: With respect to the 2020 Main Street Mortgage Loan (8.8%), (i) the third largest tenant, New York Life Insurance Company, has one-time right to terminate its lease effective February 28, 2028 with notice on or before February 28, 2027 and payment of a termination fee equal to two months of base rent (including CAM), plus unamortized tenant improvement, leasing costs and free rent, and (ii) the fifth largest tenant, GSA, Public Buildings Service, has an ongoing right to terminate its lease at any time effective on or after January 29, 2029 with 90 days’ notice (no termination fee).
